title: Microcentrifuge Tubes

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Small (commonly 0.5–2 mL), conical-bottomed tubes with a snap or screw cap, used in a microcentrifuge for small-volume sample handling.
safety: Ensure caps are fully closed before centrifugation to prevent leaks/aerosol release.
Balance tubes across the rotor by mass, as with any centrifugation.
